platform_safe.source:
raw = string!(.message)
assert!(length(raw) <= 4095, "invalid_safe_event")
assert!(!contains(raw, "\r"), "invalid_safe_event")
. = object!(parse_json!(raw))
assert!(length(keys(.)) == 12 && exists(.correlation_id) && exists(.duration_ms) && exists(.error_code) && exists(.event) && exists(.event_id) && exists(.instance_id) && exists(.level) && exists(.outcome) && exists(.schema_version) && exists(.sequence) && exists(.service) && exists(.timestamp), "invalid_safe_event")
assert!(.schema_version == "1.0.0", "invalid_safe_event")
assert!(includes(["platform"], .service), "invalid_safe_event")
sequence = int!(.sequence)
assert!(sequence >= 1, "invalid_safe_event")
assert!(includes(["DEBUG", "INFO", "WARNING", "ERROR", "CRITICAL"], .level), "invalid_safe_event")
assert!(includes(["started", "succeeded", "failed", "cancelled", "unknown", "rejected", "degraded"], .outcome), "invalid_safe_event")
assert!(includes(["cli.action.finished", "cli.action.started", "config.load_failed", "config.loaded", "contract.loaded", "contract.verify_failed", "http.auth.rejected", "http.auth.succeeded", "http.request.finished", "http.request.started", "http.request.unknown_path", "logging.capacity_exhausted", "logging.recovered", "logging.segment_sealed", "logging.unavailable", "outbound.call.cancelled", "outbound.call.failed", "outbound.call.queued", "outbound.call.started", "outbound.call.succeeded", "outbound.call.timed_out", "runtime.started", "runtime.starting", "runtime.startup_failed", "runtime.stopped", "runtime.stopping"], .event), "invalid_safe_event")
assert!(is_null(.error_code) || includes(["budget_exceeded", "config_load_failed", "control_in_progress", "control_unverified", "core_web_not_connected", "cursor_conflict", "deadline_exceeded", "dependency_unavailable", "forbidden", "idempotency_conflict", "internal_error", "invalid_input", "invalid_upstream", "log_capacity_exhausted", "log_directory_unusable", "log_flush_timeout", "log_queue_full", "log_record_invalid", "log_write_failed", "not_found", "outbound_not_sent", "persona_read_required", "publication_unverified", "queue_full", "result_unknown", "session_expired", "state_conflict", "timeout", "too_many_requests", "unauthorized", "version_conflict", "web_not_configured"], .error_code), "invalid_safe_event")
if !is_null(.duration_ms) { assert!(is_integer(.duration_ms) || is_float(.duration_ms), "invalid_safe_event"); elapsed_ms = to_float!(.duration_ms); assert!(elapsed_ms >= 0.0, "invalid_safe_event") }
if !is_null(.correlation_id) { assert!(match(string!(.correlation_id), r'^[a-f0-9]{32}$'), "invalid_safe_event") }
assert!(match(string!(.instance_id), r'^[a-fA-F0-9]{8}(-[a-fA-F0-9]{4}){3}-[a-fA-F0-9]{12}$'), "invalid_safe_event")
assert!(match(string!(.event_id), r'^[a-fA-F0-9]{8}(-[a-fA-F0-9]{4}){3}-[a-fA-F0-9]{12}$'), "invalid_safe_event")
original_time = parse_timestamp!(string!(.timestamp), format: "%+")
._collected_at = now()
